seo.title: TP-C120 Rutile Titanium Dioxide for Water-Based Paint | TIOVAR
seo.description: TP-C120 is a chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment with zirconium-aluminum and special organic surface treatment for water-based interior and exterior wall emulsion paints. Its product profile includes relatively low viscosity, bluish tone, high gloss, high hiding power and high durability.

hero.headline: TIOVAR TP‑C120 Rutile Titanium Dioxide
hero.directAnswer: TP‑C120 is a chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment with zirconium-aluminum and special organic surface treatment for water-based interior and exterior wall emulsion paints. Its product profile includes relatively low viscosity, bluish tone, high gloss, high hiding power and high durability.

formulationPriorities.title: Viscosity
formulationPriorities.explanation: Compare slurry and finished-paint viscosity in the intended formulation.

formulationPriorities.title: Hiding power
formulationPriorities.explanation: Measure wet and dry opacity at the target pigment loading and film thickness.

formulationPriorities.title: Bluish tone & whiteness
formulationPriorities.explanation: Compare dry L*, dry b*, CBU and visual color against the formulation target.

formulationPriorities.title: Gloss
formulationPriorities.explanation: Measure gloss after the selected dispersion, application and cure procedure.

formulationPriorities.title: Durability
formulationPriorities.explanation: Check scrub, washability and exterior exposure where required.

validationSteps.title: Define the formulation
validationSteps.description: Binder chemistry, PVC, solids, dispersant package, pigment loading and application method.

validationSteps.title: Optimize dispersion
validationSteps.description: Compare viscosity across the agreed shear range and optimize dispersant demand first.

validationSteps.title: Measure color and hiding
validationSteps.description: Wet and dry opacity, dry L*, dry b*, CBU and visual whiteness.

validationSteps.title: Check stability
validationSteps.description: Grind quality, fineness, storage stability and application behavior.

validationSteps.title: Validate the film
validationSteps.description: Gloss, scrub, washability and film appearance after the selected cure.

validationSteps.title: Test exterior use
validationSteps.description: Run exterior exposure or accelerated weathering where required.

faqs.question: What is TIOVAR TP‑C120?
faqs.answerHtml: TP‑C120 is a TIOVAR premium-positioned, chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment intended for water-based interior and exterior wall emulsion paints.

faqs.question: What coating applications is TP‑C120 intended for?
faqs.answerHtml: TP‑C120 is intended for water-based interior and exterior wall emulsion paints.

faqs.question: What surface treatment does TP‑C120 use?
faqs.answerHtml: TP‑C120 uses zirconium-aluminum and special organic surface treatment.

faqs.question: Is TP‑C120 suitable for interior and exterior wall paint?
faqs.answerHtml: TP‑C120 is intended for water-based interior and exterior wall emulsion paints. Final performance should be confirmed in the intended formulation.

faqs.question: Which properties should be checked during formulation trials?
faqs.answerHtml: Check viscosity, dispersant demand, grind quality, hiding, dry color, gloss, storage stability, scrub, washability and exterior durability where required.

faqs.question: How can I request a TDS or sample?
faqs.answerHtml: Include TP‑C120, the binder, PVC range, viscosity target, application and destination market with the enquiry.
